comment: The statement that the economic cost of fragmentation “grows quadratically” is only strictly valid under an all-to-all point-to-point integration model. Not every system necessarily connects to every other system.

anchor.note: p.28 l.Lines 283-290 read as the printed page; section 1.3.1 does NOT agree

public.text: The statement that the economic cost of fragmentation “grows quadratically” is only strictly valid under an all-to-all point-to-point integration model. Not every system necessarily connects to every other system.
public.suggestedRevision: Qualify the claim: “In the worst case, a point-to-point integration landscape can approach quadratic growth as the number of connected systems increases.”
